name: KasuMeta
description: Stores localized metadata beside Jellyfin (its own SQLite file) and serves it to client apps through /KasuMeta endpoints: titles, overviews, taglines and artwork per locale from TMDB, anime titles from AniList, search by localized name, and admin overrides. Stock clients are unaffected. Requires Jellyfin 12.x and a TMDB API key.
overview: Localized titles, overviews and artwork for every user's language

versions.changelog: 1.0.0: first release. Localized titles, overviews, taglines and artwork from TMDB, anime titles from AniList, search by localized name, admin overrides, and a status panel on the plugin page. Requires Jellyfin 12.x and a TMDB API key.
